what_it_does: Swarm optimizer (plist declares 03:45 and 15:45). The plist exists in ~/Library/LaunchAgents but the label is ABSENT from launchctl list: NOT_LOADED.
why_it_matters: A not-loaded plist is a real outage that looks like nothing at all — no failing exit code is ever produced because nothing ever runs. A stub-backup file sitting beside the plist suggests an unfinished configuration change rather than a deliberate stop.
